analyst: The script enters long or short when price crosses the 25-bar VWMA in the direction of the VWMA slope, provided the volume-profile POC delta imbalance exceeds a set percentage of POC volume. The stop is a fixed dollar amount (default $250) divided by the point value to get points, placed on the far side of the entry close, and a matching take-profit is set on the other side. A session filter (default 18:00 to 08:00 ET) gates all entries and force-closes any open position the moment the session ends. Daily loss and profit dollar limits can lock the strategy out of further trading for the rest of the day, and an optional trailing stop tightens the exit incrementally as unrealized profit grows.
